description: Java class defining AccountTransferTransaction entity for handling account transfer records, including methods for creating different transfer types and managing transaction details.

classes.name: AccountTransferTransaction
classes.description: Entity class representing account transfer transactions, with fields for linked transactions, amount, date, currency, and transfer details.

methods.name: savingsToSavingsTransfer
methods.description: Creates a transfer record for savings to savings transfer.

methods.name: savingsToLoanTransfer
methods.description: Creates a transfer record for savings to loan transfer.

methods.name: loanTosavingsTransfer
methods.description: Creates a transfer record for loan to savings transfer.

methods.name: loanToLoanTransfer
methods.description: Creates a transfer record for loan to loan transfer.

methods.name: accountTransferDetails
methods.description: Returns the associated account transfer details.
